bio.en:
Professor of Industrial Pharmacy, College of Pharmacy, Sookmyung Women's University.
Editorial Board Member, Journal of Controlled Release.
Conducts research on pulsed-laser-, cold-plasma-, and NIR-light-responsive drug delivery systems and cell-specific mRNA lipid nanoparticles.
bio.ko:
숙명여자대학교 약학대학 산업약학 교수
Journal of Controlled Release 편집위원.
Pulsed laser, Cold plasma, NIR light 감응형 약물전달시스템, 세포 특이적 mRNA 지질나노입자 연구 수행

text.en: Ph.D. in Pharmacy, Dept. of Pharmaceutical Sciences, Seoul National University (Advisors: Prof. Yu-Kyoung Oh, Prof. Wooin Lee). Thesis: "Programmed drug delivery systems activated in the fibrotic and tumor microenvironment."

text.en: B.S., Pharm.D., College of Pharmacy, Ajou University.
Undergraduate studies in Physics, Yonsei University (transferred to Ajou University College of Pharmacy).
